review: The curve is out of order. Saw Mill at stage 3 kills more than half the field and all three recorded players, including the high-skill one; the saws hang in mid-air at jump height and the deaths are spread along the whole upper deck, so it looks like timing luck, not a line I can learn. Ferry Lines hides its only saw at 80%, after ten seconds of waiting on platforms. Spring Loaded is a free stage: 92 of 100 finish and the one saw is far above the route. Spike Garden, Crumble Bridge, Laser Gate and Gauntlet are tight, readable and fast.
best: Gauntlet mixes all the mechanics in 14 seconds and each death there has a clear cause.
worst: Saw Mill is harder than the final stage and Spring Loaded, three stages later, has almost no risk.
